claims: UFC 327: Procházka vs. Ulberg takes place on Saturday, April 11, 2026, at the Kaseya Center in Miami, FL.
The UFC 327 main card begins at 9 p.m. ET (6 p.m. PT) on Paramount+.
The UFC 327 prelims start at 5:30 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
Jiří Procházka vs. Carlos Ulberg is the light heavyweight title bout on the UFC 327 main card.
Azamat Murzakanov vs. Paulo Costa is a light heavyweight bout on the UFC 327 main card.
Curtis Blaydes vs. Josh Hokit is a heavyweight bout on the UFC 327 main card.
Dominick Reyes vs. Johnny Walker is a light heavyweight bout on the UFC 327 main card.
Cub Swanson vs. Nate Landwehr is a featherweight bout and the main card opener on UFC 327.
Patricio Pitbull vs. Aaron Pico is the featured prelim on UFC 327.
Kevin Holland vs. Randy Brown is a welterweight bout on the UFC 327 prelims.
Mateusz Gamrot vs. Esteban Ribovics is a lightweight bout on the UFC 327 prelims.
Tatiana Suarez vs. Loopy Godínez is a women's strawweight bout on the UFC 327 prelims.
The UFC 327 live event is streaming in its entirety on Paramount+.
